title: Use of the Triggering Receptor Expressed on Myeloid Cells-1 (TREM-1) in the Diagnosis of Pleural Effusion
brief_summary: The aim of this trial is to evaluate the level of TREM-1 in different kinds of pleural effusion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of pleural effusion
* Pleural effusion proved by chest sonography

Exclusion Criteria:

* Conditions for which thoracentesis are contraindicated
* Pregnancy
